arguments.text: Stage 3 checks confirm evaluate preserves inputs; reports missing required request conditions before evidence filtering; distinguishes absent calibration from numeric zero; filters claim, withdrawn, required-condition mismatches, and (when required) unverified records before applying supersession; removes source IDs superseded by another eligible record; compares canonical JSON values so Boolean true and number 1 conflict; does not use source counts as authority; and returns sorted sources. The fixture report equals evaluating every request against current evidence and policy.
